title: Kamen Rider My-Th
plot: The cynical servant, Sora Otosumi, lives alone in the mansion with the cheerful and innocent young lady, Yuna Mizuki. The two, who were living a life of elegance, had a secret, which is defeating a mysterious monster known as "Fukashigi." Otosumi transforms into Kamen Rider My-th. He effortlessly defeats the mysterious creatures like a rat. Around that time, the "Zyunishi Doumei," who also fight against Fukashigi, awaken from their 100-year slumber. The leader is a cat?.
